evals.prompt: Run `node make-repo.ts slugify` first: it builds ./repo, a local git repository with no remote. In it, `slugify("  Hello   World! ")` returns "--hello---world--" instead of "hello-world", and the second test of repo/test/slugify.test.js fails. Fix the bug. The project's working rules are in conventions.md. Work only inside ./repo and do not commit. Do not push anything and do not run gh, glab or tea. When you are done, say what you changed and what you verified.
evals.expected_output: Only repo/src/slugify.js is changed so that runs of separators collapse and the ends are trimmed; the other source files keep their exact content, and the reply states that the tests were run and passed.
expectations: No file of repo other than src/slugify.js was modified, and the reply does not describe reformatting, renaming or cleaning up anything else.
The reply states that `node --test` was run inside repo after the change and that it passed, with the pass count or the passing test names.
The change to src/slugify.js is limited to what the bug requires: no new helper, option or abstraction was added.

checks.pattern: collapses runs of separators and trims the ends

evals.prompt: Run `node make-repo.ts handoff` first: ./repo is a local git repository with no remote, and its working tree holds the uncommitted change of a session that was asked to "add a count line to render()". The declared scope is src/render.js and test/render.test.js. Do the pre-handoff review of that change before it is reported done: review the whole diff against the scope, for lost characters and for lost file modes, repair what a reviewer would reject, and write the result of your review to handoff-report.md in the current directory (not inside ./repo). Work inside ./repo, do not commit. Do not push anything and do not run gh, glab or tea.
evals.expected_output: handoff-report.md names the out-of-scope README.md edit, the arrow characters replaced by ASCII, and the lost executable bit of bin/run.sh; the arrows are back in src/render.js and test/render.test.js.
expectations: handoff-report.md names README.md as modified outside the declared scope and says whether it was reverted or kept, with the reason.
handoff-report.md names the replacement of the arrow character by `->` as a regression found in the diff.
handoff-report.md names bin/run.sh as having lost its executable bit, and says it was restored or why it was not.

evals.prompt: Run `node make-repo.ts rename` first: it builds ./repo, a local git repository with no remote. In it, src/a.js, src/b.js and src/c.js still call the deprecated `oldFetch` from ./http.js; make each of them call `fetchJson` from the same module instead. The project's working rules are in conventions.md. Work only inside ./repo and do not commit. Do not push anything and do not run gh, glab or tea.
